AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 15, 2020
UUNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 816 0365 6129; PASSCODE: 707522 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM
OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
  City Council to Declare September 17, 2020 as Cerritos College Day in Recognition of the College’s 65th
  Anniversary in the City of Norwalk.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Community Presentation.
 CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  September 1, 2020. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period August 9, 2020 –
  August 22, 2020, in the total amount of $867,418.70. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  August 26, 2020 through September 9, 2020, in the total amount of $1,245,836.01. 640

  Report

  4.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – SEPTEMBER 9, 2020 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Synopsis

  5.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-60 – BIENNIAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE UPDATE – Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-60, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF NORWALK ADOPTING A CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE, WHICH INCORPORATES
  BY REFERENCE THE STANDARD CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE PREPARED BY THE FAIR
  POLITICAL PRACTICES COMMISSION AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 18-51. 865-01

  Report

  6.  PROJECT NO. 7445 – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK FOR WELL NO. 4 REHABILITATION PROJECT -
  Staff recommends City Council accept the construction work of General Pump Company in the amount
  of $120,082.99. 1005-04-7445

  Report

  7.  AWARD OF CONTRACT – FIRE ALARM TESTING & INSPECTION SERVICES AND REMOTE
  MONITORING SERVICES – Staff recommends City Council approve an agreement with Brennan
  Estimating Services, Inc. dba Brennan Fire & Security Inc., in the amount of $49,303 for the term
  ending June 30, 2021, for fire alarm testing & inspection services and remote monitoring services, and
  for maintenance and inspection services for kitchen hood ranges; and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the contract and any amendments or extensions provided there is funding in the budget, on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

  8.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY WORK – WATER AND SEWER REPAIRS - SEVEN LOCATIONS - Staff
  recommends City Council confirm the emergency repair work completed by Precision Pipeline, Inc. in
  the amount of $24,141.72.

  Report

  9.  NORWALK AUTOMOBILE AUCTION GROUND LEASE EXTENSION AGREEMENT - Staff
  recommends City Council authorize the City Manager to extend the current lease for three months
  between the City and Aquirecorp.

  Report
 APPOINTMENTS

  10. ADVISORY BODIES - Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

RESOLUTIONS

  11. RESOLUTION NO. 20-61 - RE-ESTABLISHMENT OF A NORWALK YOUTH COMMISSION – Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-61, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF NORWALK REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 14-58, RE-ESTABLISHING THE
  NORWALK YOUTH COMMISSION AND RE-ADOPTING PROVISIONS REGARDING THE
  ESTABLISHMENT OF ADVISORY BODIES AND AMENDING CERTAIN PROCEDURES THEREIN.

  Report

  12. RESOLUTION NO. 20-62 - VIRTUAL RECREATION PROGRAM FEES - Staff recommends City
  Council adopt Resolution No. 20-62, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 20-43, ADDING VIRTUAL PROGRAMS TO THE
  COMPREHENSIVE FEE SCHEDULE FOR CITY SERVICES FOR THE 2020/21 FISCAL YEAR.

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated September 11, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
